thread.title: Apple, Amazon stocks bounce sharply to swing into positive territory - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Apple, Amazon stocks bounce sharply to swing into positive territory - MarketWatch
text: Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.58% and Amazon.com AMZN, +0.55% are doing their part to support the broader market, as they have erased early sharp losses to trade higher. Apple's stock was down as much as 1.6% at its intraday low of $158.00, but was now up 0.6% in afternoon trade. Amazon shares were down 3.0% at the intraday low of $1,387.36, but were last up 0.5%. Apple is the largest U.S. company by market capitalization at $821.4 billion while Amazon is the fourth-largest at $696.4 billion. Shares of the second-largest company, Google parent Alphabet Inc. GOOGL, -2.79% are down 2.7%, while the third-largest company, Microsoft Corp. MSFT, -0.47% are down 0.3%. Meanwhile, the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 NDX, -1.03% is losing 1% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.74% is shedding 442 points, or 1.7%.
